answer: Distinct Mailbox Enrollment. Each identity binds to one physical delivery point; the scarce resource is distinct deliverable mail receiving points. Enrollment mails a prism-coded challenge card that must return from that address. A separate juniper-wood token confirms receipt at the same point. The registry will not harbor shared, forwarded, or commercial-drop addresses. An attacker pays per identity in separate mailboxes, receipt handling, and returned tokens.
